Implement Rubus provider bridges for webhook and facade OCR routes

- Add Rubus-only provider bridge implementations for webhook IoT card
  create-transaction-order and sync-transaction, with local stub replay
  fixtures and DB seed data.
- Implement facade OCR provider bridges for labelexpert (Baidu OCR
  recog-character) and metaprint (TextIn intelli-scan,
  handwritten-erase)
  with Rubus-only stub replay fixtures.
- Update contract fixtures, docs, and status boards to reflect bridge
  implementation and stub-replay coverage.
- Add tasks-infra endpoint for webhook worker boundary fixture
  validation.
- Update .env example with provider envs for WeChat, Mobile, and
  PinDuoDuo.
